scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,white "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c red,white "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client -- --host 0.0.0.0"
